# Cramio

> Cramio is a focused study space: notes, PDFs, AI study chat, quizzes, and flashcards in one place. Tagline: "Cram less. Learn more."

Study app for students. Android-first: the Android app installs from https://github.com/ravvdevv/cramio-landing/releases/latest/download/cramio-v1.0.3.apk, and everything else runs at https://app.cramio.site on iPhone, iPad, or a computer with nothing to install. Same account everywhere.

## Get It

- [Android app (direct download)](https://github.com/ravvdevv/cramio-landing/releases/latest/download/cramio-v1.0.3.apk): install on an Android phone
- [Web app](https://app.cramio.site/): open on any device, nothing to install, same account

## What Cramio does

- Keeps notes, PDFs, AI study chat, quizzes, and flashcards together in one focused space
- Built Android-first; on any other device Cramio opens right on the website with nothing to install: same study space and account
- Some content can be available offline on-device; AI chat, sign-in, and cloud sync need internet

## FAQ

- Can I use Cramio on the web? Yes: just open this website on an iPhone, iPad, or computer. Nothing to install, same account everywhere.
- Does Cramio work offline? Some on-device content may; AI chat, sign-in, and cloud sync need a connection.
- Is there an Android app? Yes: install the app from https://github.com/ravvdevv/cramio-landing/releases/latest/download/cramio-v1.0.3.apk, and everyone else can use Cramio right on the website.
- What can I study with Cramio? Your notes and PDFs, topic questions, quizzes, and flashcards; you pick what and when.
